pageDescription: Curated questions with hints, audio prompts, and model answers for IELTS & PTE practice

questions.title: Describe a memorable journey you went on
questions.instructions: You have 1 minute to think and take notes, then speak for 1 to 2 minutes.
prompts: What did you do during the trip?
Why was this journey memorable to you?
questions.modelAnswer: One of the most memorable trips I have taken was to Pokhara with my school friends two years ago. We enjoyed boating on Phewa Lake and watched the sunrise over the Annapurna mountains...

questions.title: Should children be given homework every day?
questions.instructions: Write an essay of at least 250 words. Give reasons and include relevant examples.
questions.promptText: Some people believe that school children should be given daily homework, while others think it puts too much pressure on young minds. Do you agree or disagree?

suggestedOutline.introduction: Introduce the topic and state your clear opinion
suggestedOutline.bodyParagraph1: Explain the benefits of revision and practice at home
suggestedOutline.bodyParagraph2: Discuss the need for balanced playtime and mental rest
suggestedOutline.conclusion: Summarize key points and restate your final verdict

questions.title: Honeybee Communication in the Hive
questions.passage: Honeybees use an extraordinary waggle dance to communicate the distance and direction of nectar sources to other bees in their colony. Karl von Frisch first deciphered this dance in 1944. Research suggests that bees can travel up to five kilometers from their hive to collect nectar.

statements.text: Karl von Frisch discovered the meaning of the bee dance in 1944.
statements.explanation: The text directly states that Karl von Frisch deciphered the dance in 1944.

statements.text: Honeybees only collect nectar in sunny weather.
statements.explanation: The passage never mentions sunny weather or rain.

statements.text: Bees never fly more than one kilometer away from their hive.
statements.explanation: The text says bees can travel up to five kilometers, which is more than one kilometer.
